summary.text: Marty Gearheart is a Republican business owner and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 37 who is seeking re-election against Democrat Treyvon Simmons in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2010 to 2018 and returned in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Marty Gearheart was born in Zebulon, North Carolina, graduated from Bluefield High School in 1979 and earned a B.S. from Concord University in 1983.
His career experience includes owning and managing Gearheart Enterprises.
Gearheart represented West Virginia House of Delegates District 27 from 2010 to 2018 and has represented District 37 since 2020.
His committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Finance, Rules, Technology and Infrastructure, and Workforce Development.
